title: Recalibrate the Space
style: Alternative R&B, Quiet-Storm; unhurried late-night sway, warm tape saturation, warm husky female mid-range lead with layered chorus vocals, sparse soft Rhodes, subtle bass, restrained beat.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The things that sit a little out of place
When I walk in and close the door
I know that Michael never would have touched
Those small disturbances before
The scent that lingers soft inside his clothes
From trips that take him far away
I travel too, yet something in the air
Is not from airports or hotels that day

[Pre-Chorus]
I cannot know for sure, and still I stay
I will not ask, I do not want to know
We never spoke the words that draw the lines
And I refuse to start that talk and go

[Chorus]
’Cause I myself rely on this ambiguity
I love him true, don’t get me wrong
But I must gently recalibrate the space
It is not cheating if the core stays strong

[Verse 2]
The hidden folder locked inside his phone
I know the code, yet leave it be
When we are home he stays right here with me
And that is all that ever needs to be

[Pre-Chorus]
I cannot know for sure, and still I stay
I will not ask, I do not want to know
If limits never get a spoken name
Then I refuse to start that talk and go

[Chorus]
’Cause I myself rely on this ambiguity
I love him true, don’t get me wrong
But I must gently recalibrate the space
It is not cheating if our home stays home

[Bridge]
If we should ever speak about the next
Then we would finally have the talk
Would we place careful limits on ourselves
Or keep the open doors and never lock
It might be time to take this seriously
If we decide to take that further step

[Final Chorus]
’Cause I will no longer lean on ambiguity
I love him true, and that will mean something more
Then it will be the time to name the lines
And what would count as cheating from that door
